description: This file implements the LocalStore class, which manages database operations such as opening a database, creating tables, setting limits, retrieving entries, and removing entries. It interacts with a database connection and performs SQL queries to manage stored data.

classes.name: LocalStore
classes.description: A class that provides methods to manage a local database, including opening connections, creating tables, setting limits, retrieving, adding, and removing entries.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a database connection at the specified path, creating the database file if it does not exist.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a new table in the database with a specified name.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets a maximum page count limit for the database.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of entries in a table, starting from a specific ID and up to a maximum count.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entries from a table starting from a specific index.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Removes entries from a table within a specified ID range.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to a specified table.

methods.name: buildGetEventsQuery
methods.description: Constructs an SQL query to retrieve a range of entries from a table.
